note: The demonstration scenarios of the Documentation Studio. Every organization, product, person and address in them is fictional. Documents are in the workbench's Markdown; the samples named under each scenario are made by scripts/studio-samples.py and lib/samples.mjs.

scenarios.title: Preventive maintenance: monthly equipment inspection
scenarios.summary: A technician inspects a feed pump every month, records four readings and closes the work order. The scenario shows an engineering procedure with prerequisites and cautions, an inspection record, annotated console screenshots, a revision-controlled procedure, and a narrated walkthrough.

scenarios.title: Employee onboarding and access provisioning
scenarios.product: Meridian Identity and the Service Desk portal
scenarios.summary: A logistics company brings a new employee from a signed offer to a working account in a week. The scenario shows a standard operating procedure, a responsibility matrix, the hands-on provisioning procedure, an explanation of the approval workflow, a troubleshooting article, an internal knowledge base, and an illustrated step guide.

scenarios.title: Deploying and configuring a cloud service
scenarios.product: Lattice Relay, a managed webhook relay
scenarios.summary: A developer deploys a webhook relay from the command line, configures it with one file and three environment variables, and verifies a delivery. The scenario shows a developer guide with prerequisites, code and placeholders, a configuration reference, a troubleshooting article, and an explainer of how the service works.

scenarios.title: Investigating a simulated Wazuh security alert
scenarios.product: a SOC console fed by Wazuh
scenarios.summary: An analyst on shift works a brute-force alert from the alert to a closed, blocked or escalated case. The scenario shows an incident runbook with decision points, an explanation of the security event behind the alert, an escalation matrix, and annotated console screenshots. All data is simulated, with no real addresses or credentials.

scenarios.title: Resolving a SaaS product access problem
scenarios.product: Ledgerly, a small-business accounting application, and its support console
scenarios.summary: A customer is locked out before payroll. The scenario shows a help center in the shape of Zendesk Guide: categories and sections, a troubleshooting tree, an FAQ, customer-facing procedures, agent-facing internal articles kept apart from them, and a content revision. It also shows the agent's procedure as an illustrated guide.

scenarios.title: Software release version 2.4
scenarios.summary: A release with three new features, five fixed issues, known limitations and a removed API. The scenario shows release notes, a migration guide for administrators, and a version history with a change-impact table by role.

scenarios.title: Using a new software feature
scenarios.summary: A two-minute tutorial on scheduling a report for automatic delivery. The scenario shows annotated screenshots, a numbered procedural guide, a narrated training video with pointer effects and captions, and a downloadable training package.

scenarios.title: Multi-topic product documentation in DITA
scenarios.summary: Five DITA projects made from the scenarios' documents: concepts, tasks, references and troubleshooting topics under a map with keys, a relationship table and DITAVAL filters for each group of readers, validated against the OASIS DTDs and published to HTML5 and PDF.
